notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing itself.
Arcbound Ravager dies, triggering its modular ability, putting all +1/+1 counters from it onto Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Ravager from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Arcbound Ravager from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile this turn, and dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Arcbound Ravager from exile by paying {2}.
Arcbound Ravager enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
